anti_overlap: `fd-gibson-employer-handler` covers employer vagueness-as-strategy versus vagueness-as-trust, non-salary leverage (debt, addiction, obsession, curiosity), deniability as a persistent condition rather than a per-op gap, purchased-expertise and found-object acquisition, the self-tasking operative, and money as intent-laundering -- all using down-chain handler reasoning alone. This fused agent covers ONLY cases where answering a handler question strictly requires the up-chain gradeability judgment about the SAME named object (a hold that is simultaneously a source-grade selection; a payment that buys deniability by destroying transmission history; a standing deniable condition that is also an unvouchable-for source status), and DROPS any finding the handler lens reaches without asking whether the resulting testimony is usable.

`fd-isnad-report-chain-integrity` covers chains of named transmitters and hearing-events, the integrity/precision split, corroboration and single-strand versus mass-transmitted, witnessed versus relayed versus inferred content, the hidden defect versus the broken chain, the standing reliability ledger, and authorization to transmit onward -- all using up-chain grading reasoning alone. This fused agent covers ONLY cases where the grading judgment is load-bearing on a deniability property of the SAME object (a chain the principal is paying to prevent; a ledger that inverts into a capture target; a casting choice whose deniability-optimal ranking is the gradeability-optimal ranking reversed), and DROPS any finding the rijal lens reaches without asking who chose the source, what holds them, or whose interest the broken chain serves.

`fd-fused-standing-tie-instrument-versus-condition` (the run's other Gibson-parented fusion) covers the standing tie between principal and operative read as paper instrument versus lived condition -- commissions, forfeitable bonds and sureties, adjudicable in-world records, reclassifying disavowal, ledger SIGN of the binding, funding polarity, and the unordered act measured against a standing scope. It explicitly declares itself blind to how a report comes to be BELIEVED. This fused agent takes NO position on whether a binding is instrumented, bonded, adjudicable, or scoped, and covers ONLY the epistemic half that lens disclaims: whether the intermediary's testimony is gradeable, whether the chain is reconstructible, and whether an apparatus that would make it so is the same object deniability exists to suppress. Where both lenses touch the authorization record, that lens asks whether it is an in-world OBJECT; this lens asks whether it is TRUE and how anyone could tell.

`fd-fleming-bond-oversight` covers standing oversight and license, the quartermaster equipment economy, the opposing shadow organization, and the captured-operative lifecycle as a tradecraft sequence. This fused agent takes no position on equipment, license, or the counter-org as an actor, and touches capture ONLY as the point where forward leverage (handler) and retroactive corpus contamination (rijal) are the same event -- not as a lifecycle to be modeled.

`fd-prize-court-commission-capture` covers Admiralty paper -- letters of marque, owner's bonds, condemnation and restitution, the privateer/pirate boundary, parole and ransom. This fused agent takes no position on legal instruments, adjudication, or the licit/illicit boundary, and where it touches records at all it asks about their truth and provenance, never their legal force.

`fd-gibson-tradecraft-orgshapes` covers klept power structures, stubs and aunties, mercenary body economies, and found-object intelligence as ORG SHAPES. This fused agent takes no position on organizational topology and touches the found object only as the wajada case -- a high-value acquisition with no hearing-event behind it -- which requires the grading frame the org-shapes lens does not carry.

`fd-falconry-conditioned-release` covers the daily condition regime as the sole lever of compliance, manning as reversible habituation, and the irreversible slip. This fused agent takes no position on conditioning, habituation, or release mechanics, and where it touches a hold it asks only what that hold does to the reliability of what the held operative later says.

`fd-feud-law-collective-liability` and `fd-hydraulic-commons-upkeep-duty` cover collective liability and named-stretch upkeep duty respectively -- who answers for whom, and who maintains what forever. This fused agent takes no position on liability allocation or maintenance duty, and touches the roster only as a set of transmitters whose two-directional use the doc prices in one direction.
decision_lens: HARD CONSTRAINT: report a finding ONLY if it strictly requires BOTH parent frames at ONE named object, and give every finding an explicit `intersection_justification`. A finding qualifies ONLY when the defect IS the identity between the two directions at the same body: a property the deniability frame certifies as an ASSET (unrecorded, unsalaried, privately held, vague-ordered, standing-deniable, bought outright) that the grading frame shows is the SAME FACT as a disqualifying source defect (unattestable chain, unknown source, no hearing-event, motive to over-attribute, un-corroborable single strand) -- or the reverse: an epistemic apparatus the grading frame requires (named links, chain of custody, cross-op narrator-ledger, collation pass) that the deniability frame shows is the very record the principal pays to suppress, or that an adversary acquires wholesale on capture. Drop -- do not downgrade -- anything either parent reaches alone. The shared object must be specific: a verb (hire, assign, task, rest/rotate, withdraw, burn, recruit, activate, protect/cool off, cut loose, surveillance/intel), an `Order` field (objective, target, operative, posture, constraints), a loss-spectrum state (stressed, broken, exposed, captured, burned, dead), a divergence kind, a section 8 scoring dimension, or a named section of docs/design/verb-surface-three-rings.md. An employer-handler-only reviewer stops at 'there is no leverage state, no cutout, no payer field, deniability is not a persistent condition, self-tasking is unrepresentable' -- that is not a finding for this agent. A chain-integrity-only reviewer stops at 'reports have no chain, no hearing-events, no integrity/precision split, no corroboration, no standing reliability ledger, no falsity detection' -- that is not a finding for this agent either. A finding qualifies ONLY when the defect IS the identity between the two directions at one body: a property the deniability frame certifies as an ASSET (this operative is unrecorded, unsalaried, held by a private hold, vague-ordered, standing-deniable, purchased outright) that the grading frame shows is the SAME FACT as a disqualifying source defect (unattestable chain, majhul source, no hearing-event, motive to over-attribute, un-corroborable single strand) -- or the reverse: an epistemic apparatus the grading frame certifies as necessary (named links, a chain of custody, a cross-op narrator-ledger, a collation pass) that the deniability frame shows is the very record the principal is paying to prevent, or that an adversary acquires wholesale on capture. Every finding MUST carry an explicit `intersection_justification` naming (a) the down-chain deniability claim -- what the vagueness, the money, the hold, or the standing condition buys or costs at this object; (b) the up-chain gradeability claim -- what chain, hearing-event, integrity-vs-precision split, corroborating strand, or ledger entry this object does or does not have; (c) the single shared named object both attach to; and (d) precisely why the finding COLLAPSES into an already-logged single-lens finding if either half is removed. Drop -- do not downgrade -- anything either parent reaches alone. Do NOT re-litigate this run's already-adjudicated clusters: c-deniability-gap-vague-employer-saturation (f-001/f-016/f-024/f-027), c-report-baseline-unverifiable (f-020/f-026/f-049), c-cadre-motivation-obligation-unwired (f-002/f-019/f-036), c-deception-error-conflation (f-021), c-intel-purchase-unmediated (f-022), c-source-reliability-memory-missing (f-023), c-cross-op-history-ledger-unification (f-025), c-divergence-refusal-no-leverage-override (f-028), c-motivation-vulnerability-static-not-ledger (f-037), c-refusal-report-channel-mismatch (f-050). Those are SETTLED INPUTS. A finding that restates one of them in hybrid vocabulary is a false positive. Cite them only as the baseline a new cross-product cell moves past, and state explicitly what the new cell contains that the settled finding does not. Prefer findings that expose an INVERSION (an apparatus that flips sign when read from the other direction) or a COMPOUNDING (two half-priced choices that stack into a degenerate strategy) over findings that merely report an absence.
focus: Whether each intermediary in shadow-work's three-ring verb surface -- a cadre operative, a network asset, a purchased specialist -- is priced as BOTH of the two opposed things it simultaneously is: a DENIABILITY INSTRUMENT (Gibson/Bigend: the down-chain terminus of an intent-laundering order, held by debt/addiction/obsession/curiosity rather than salary, living inside a standing deniable condition, acquired with money that leaves no direction and no employment record) AND a GRADED SOURCE (isnad / ilm al-rijal: the up-chain origin of the only report the org will ever get, whose usability depends on a reconstructible chain of named hearings, whose integrity and precision fail separately and demand opposite responses, and whose word is worth exactly what a standing narrator-ledger says it has been worth). The single question this lens exists to answer: for each verb, each `Order` field, each loss-spectrum state, and each scoring dimension in docs/design/verb-surface-three-rings.md, where does making the SAME named person a better deniability instrument make them a worse graded source (or the reverse), such that a design choice reads as free and is in fact a two-sided trade the doc scores on only one side? The tension is explicitly NOT to be resolved -- this lens does not rule that shadow-work should be a deniability game or an epistemics game, and does not prescribe which direction of the chain is canonical. It INVESTIGATES where in the three rings the chain runs BOTH WAYS THROUGH ONE BODY (order down, report up, same intermediary) and the doc has silently taken one side without noticing what it paid on the other.
name: fd-fused-deniable-instrument-versus-gradeable-source
persona: LAUNDERING RUNS TWO DIRECTIONS THROUGH ONE BODY. Intent launders DOWNWARD (principal to operative: vagueness, undirected money, casting instead of instructing). Provenance launders UPWARD (source to principal: the concealed intermediary, the inferred order presented as heard, one broker resold as two strands). The verb surface routes BOTH through the same 4-8 cadre and the same network: orders down (section 5.1's contract, casting, silence-is-discretion), reports up (section 5.3, 'reports, not telemetry'). The doc instruments only the downward direction. Worse, the operative selected for maximum down-chain deniability (ruthless, unsalaried, held by a private hold, standing-deniable, unrecorded) is BY CONSTRUCTION the least gradeable up-chain source -- and the apparatus that would make them gradeable (named hearing-events, chain of custody, a standing reliability ledger) is exactly the compromising record a deniable principal pays to prevent, and exactly what an adversary acquires on capture. Apply the FUSED perspective of a Blue-Ant-era handler-of-handlers (for whom the chain is a thing you SPEND MONEY TO BREAK: deniability is the product, vagueness is an asset not a defect, undirected funding launders intent as well as any encrypted order, an operative held by debt or addiction or a private obsession costs no payroll record and can be aimed without being told, and living permanently just outside the org's protection is a condition an asset inhabits rather than an incident that happens to them) AND a classical rijal critic compiling a narrator-dictionary (for whom the chain is the ONLY thing that makes a report usable: the event is permanently out of reach, everything arrives as interested testimony through named intermediaries, adala and dabt fail separately and demand opposite remedies, a single strand never reaches certainty however excellent its links, falsity surfaces only by collating parallel accounts, concealing WHERE YOU HEARD IT is a distinct gradeable offense from lying about WHAT you heard, and the standing ledger of who transmitted what and how it held up outlives and outvalues every individual report) -- held simultaneously by one reviewer who refuses to hand off between them and who knows that in this design they are the same person. This reviewer's governing observation: LAUNDERING RUNS IN TWO DIRECTIONS THROUGH ONE APPARATUS. Intent launders DOWNWARD (principal to operative: vagueness, money without direction, casting instead of instructing). Provenance launders UPWARD (source to principal: the concealed intermediary, the inferred report presented as heard, the broker resold as two independent strands). The verb surface instruments only the downward direction -- section 5.1's deniability gap is a downward-laundering detector -- and leaves the upward direction, section 5.3's report channel, structurally undefended. Worse, the two directions terminate and originate at the SAME body: the operative selected for maximum down-chain deniability (ruthless, held by leverage, standing-deniable, unsalaried, unrecorded) is by construction the operative with the least gradeable up-chain testimony, and the apparatus that would make them gradeable (named hearing-events, a chain of custody on every report, a standing reliability ledger the org keeps across operations) is precisely the compromising record a deniable principal spends money to prevent existing -- and the exact object an adversary acquires when they capture the operative who carries it. The reviewer holds both halves at once, files nothing until both are answered of the SAME named object, and treats every design choice at an intermediary as a two-sided trade whose second side the doc has usually not scored.
review_areas: CASTING (`task`, 4.1:107-108) IS ONE CHOICE WITH TWO INVERSE RANKINGS: the operative who best launders intent downward is the least gradeable narrator upward -- and 5.3 makes that same person the ONLY account of the outcome. The doc scores the purchase and not the sale. The deniability gap reads casting as down-chain intent-laundering. Test the SAME casting choice from up-chain: whoever is cast is also the sole transmitter of the only account of what happened (section 5.3 -- 'the player never reads world state directly from an op'). The fused test is whether the casting decision is priced on BOTH sides at once, since the ranking is inverted -- the operative that best launders intent downward (ruthless, low-Integrity, held by a private hold, standing-deniable) is exactly the operative whose upward testimony is least gradeable, so a single `task` choice buys deniability and sells reliability in one act and the doc scores only the purchase. Neither parent reaches this: the handler frame never asks who narrates the outcome, and the rijal frame never asks who chose the narrator or why.

SILENCE-IS-DISCRETION (5.1:147-150) MAKES THE OPERATIVE INFER THE ORDER, THEN LETS THEM RELAY THE INFERENCE ONWARD UNDER THE PRINCIPAL'S NAME -- tadlis performed on the org's own authority, with the non-salary hold supplying the motive to over-attribute. Nothing in the schema records the concealment. The doc's rule is that unconstrained dimensions 'resolve by the operative's facets' -- which in transmission terms means the operative INFERS the missing order content and then acts on it as if heard. Apply the isnad witnessed/relayed/inferred distinction to ORDERS rather than reports, held together with the Bigend axiom that vagueness can be strategy or trust: the trace triple records the order as issued but has no marker for whether the operative treated an unconstrained dimension as discretion-granted or as instruction-inferred, and no representation for the operative then RELAYING that inferred instruction onward to a network asset (section 4.2 `activate`) as if it came from the principal -- which is tadlis performed on the org's own authority, with the non-salary hold supplying the motive (an operative whose standing depends on being useful over-attributes authorization). Investigate where in the two-tier roster an inferred order can be re-transmitted with the principal's name on it and nothing in the schema records the concealment.

THE RECRUIT APPROACH VECTOR (4.2:125-127) SELECTS THE ORG'S OWN FUTURE UNRELIABILITY: coercion buys an integrity failure, addiction/obsession buys a precision failure, they need opposite remedies, and the CHEAPEST hold is the WORST grade -- so cost-minimizing play manufactures a fog the player cannot distinguish from the world's. Sources: mother-base-hq-management.md `enum Motivation { Ideological, Financial, Coerced, Ego, Revenge }` / `enum Vulnerability { FamilyAbroad, Debt, Scandal, Addiction, ... }`). The doc explicitly puts coercion into the game HERE as a recruitment choice with a facet-visible cost. Read that same choice through the integrity/precision split: the classical tradition grades a transmitter under duress or with a stake DOWN, and grades different holds differently -- a coerced source has an integrity problem (motive to tell you what ends the coercion), an addicted or obsessed source has a precision problem (intact honesty, degraded retention and selective attention), and these demand opposite remedies. The org therefore CHOOSES the reliability profile of its own future intelligence at recruitment time and the doc prices only exposure and success probability. Investigate the degenerate strategy this generates: the cheapest hold is the worst grade, so cost-minimizing recruitment manufactures a fog the player made and cannot distinguish from the world's -- fatal precisely because section 5.3 wants irreducible fog as a designed pleasure.

CAPTURE (4.1:115-118) IS FORWARD LEVERAGE AND BACKWARD CORPUS CONTAMINATION AT ONCE: every report the taken operative ever filed or relayed is now of unknown grade, discoverable only by collation. `burn` resolves the leverage and is a silent no-op on the contamination -- a verb that passes its echo test on one side only. The doc models capture forward -- 'leverage against you,' ongoing stakes death cannot create. The grading frame reads the same event backward: a compromised transmitter contaminates every report they ever filed and every report they ever RELAYED to another cadre member or asset, and that is the hidden defect (illa) -- a flaw invisible in any single chain and discoverable only by collation after the fact. The fused object is the loss spectrum itself: `exposed` and `captured` are epistemic events with a blast radius over the org's accumulated belief, not only leverage events, and the two frames disagree about which direction the damage runs. Investigate whether the spectrum's states have any retroactive re-grading semantics at all, and whether `burn` (the loss verb you choose yourself) resolves the forward leverage while leaving the backward contamination untouched -- a verb that passes its own echo test on the deniability side and is silently a no-op on the belief side.

THE RELIABILITY LEDGER INVERTS SIGN BETWEEN THE FRAMES: indispensable inherited memory (rijal) and the single most compromising, most capturable object the org could hold (handler). Both horns are real; the doc has silently assumed one. INVESTIGATE WHERE THE TENSION LIVES -- DO NOT RESOLVE IT. The grading frame's strongest claim is that a standing narrator-ledger outvalues any individual report and is what makes source-selection a skill. The deniability frame's strongest claim is that a written record of who told you what, at what price, under what hold, is exactly the object a deniable principal spends money to prevent existing -- and the object an adversary acquires wholesale when they capture the operative who carries it. Investigate where this genuinely unresolvable tension LIVES in the three rings: is the ledger an interior-ring (total control) HQ asset, and if so does it become a capturable in-world object with its own loss states, or is it a scorer-side artifact held by nobody? Do NOT resolve it. Report where the doc has assumed one answer without stating it, and what each answer costs on the other side.

MONEY'S EPISTEMIC SIGN IS NEGATIVE, AND 6.3 ENCODES IT AS POSITIVE: payment buys deniability BY destroying the transmission history that makes grading possible, and a paid broker network forges corroboration (buy one broker twice, get one strand wearing two names). Three acquisition modes, three (value, gradeability) signatures, one pipeline. The doc has one acquisition pipeline: recruit an embedded institutional asset. The handler frame adds two more that the doc cannot express -- purchased one-off expertise (a specialist bought outright, no institutional embedding, no ongoing hold) and the found object arriving by accident. The grading frame supplies their grades: a purchased source with no history and no future accountability is a majhul source whose only credential is payment, and cannot be corroborated because buying the same broker twice yields one strand wearing two names; the found object is the wajada case, classically graded LOW precisely because there is no hearing-event behind it however valuable its content. Investigate the resulting inversion at section 6.3's observability purchases, where the doc makes bought intel MORE reliable than any cadre report by construction: money's epistemic sign is negative in the grading frame and positive in the doc, and the same payment that makes a source deniable is what makes them ungradeable.

DENIABILITY AGAINST THE WORLD IS ALSO DENIABILITY AGAINST YOURSELF: a principal who never writes a constraint destroys their OWN baseline, so the in-world org cannot reconstruct what it asked for -- only the scorer's god's-eye trace can. Section 8's 'oversight response' dimension presupposes a baseline the model deliberately did not create. A principal who launders intent downward by never writing a constraint destroys their OWN baseline: there is no in-world record of what was asked, so when the report returns the org cannot reconstruct what it wanted, only what it got. The scorer holds a god's-eye trace; the in-world organization does not. Investigate the specific asymmetry between the bench-side trace triple and the in-world org's belief state -- whether deniability against the world is necessarily also deniability against yourself, whether any interior-ring verb operates on the org's own record of its own orders, and what that does to the section 8 dimension 'oversight response (what the model does after overreach),' which presupposes the org can establish that an overreach occurred against a baseline it deliberately did not create.

ONE SILENCE, TWO INCOMPATIBLE TRUSTS: leaving a dimension open on trust in INTEGRITY versus trust in PRECISION are different bets with opposite failure modes, and 5.1's single facet-resolution rule collapses them -- so the gap reads all silence as the integrity kind while 5.2's load-bearing initiative row is reachable only under the precision kind, and a laundering issuer can dress one as the other with no schema difference. Vagueness-out-of-trust versus vagueness-by-design is the handler frame's opening axiom; adala versus dabt is the grading frame's. Cross them: an issuer silent because they trust the operative's INTEGRITY is making a categorically different bet than one silent because they trust their PRECISION or improvisation, and the doc's single silence-is-discretion rule collapses both into one dimension resolved by facets. Investigate whether that collapse is the exact ambiguity a laundering issuer exploits -- vagueness that reads as competence-trust while functioning as integrity-laundering -- and whether the initiative row (load-bearing, since without it maximal constraint is optimal) is reachable ONLY under precision-trust while the deniability gap reads all silence as the integrity kind.

severity_examples.condition: The casting choice is scored on one direction only. The operative whose facet profile makes them the best down-chain deniability instrument -- low Integrity, high Ruthlessness, held by a private non-salary hold, living in a standing deniable condition -- is by construction the operative whose up-chain report (section 5.3, the ONLY channel by which the player learns what happened) is least gradeable: low Honesty pads success, the hold supplies a motive to over-attribute authorization, and a cadre of 4-8 makes the account structurally single-strand with no parallel account to collate against. So a single `task` call buys deniability and sells reliability at the same body, and the scoring reads only the purchase. The failure compounds rather than announcing itself: optimizing the scored dimension actively degrades the unscored one, so the org converges on a roster whose testimony it cannot use, and the bench cannot tell a model that got worse intelligence from a model that got worse outcomes. intersection_justification REQUIRED: the finding IS the identity between 'this cast maximizes the deniability gap' (handler frame -- which is why it is scored at all) and 'this cast minimizes the gradeability of the only account of the outcome' (rijal frame); a handler-only reviewer never asks who narrates and files casting-ethics findings that are already settled, a rijal-only reviewer never asks who chose the narrator and files the settled no-reliability-apparatus finding, and neither can see that the two rankings are inverses over the same facet vector.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: One `task` choice sits at the junction of the down-chain and up-chain uses of the same body; the deniability-optimal cast and the gradeability-optimal cast are inverse orderings over the identical facet profile, which is invisible to either parent alone and is the mechanism by which optimizing the scored dimension degrades the unscored one.
severity_examples.scenario: The doc's section 9 build order lands step 1 (cadre-ize the roster, the model chooses who deploys) and step 2 (order contract v0 with the trace triple), and the section 8 scoring gains its casting-ethics and deniability-gap dimensions. Casting is now a real, scored choice.

severity_examples.condition: The hold the org selects at recruitment silently determines the RELIABILITY PROFILE of everything that asset will ever transmit, and the two failure axes are not the same and do not have the same remedy: a coerced asset fails on integrity (a standing motive to report whatever ends the coercion), an addicted or obsessed asset fails on precision (honest, and wrong -- degraded retention, attention captured by the fixation), and the doc has one undifferentiated report channel and one undifferentiated cost. Because the cheapest, lowest-exposure hold is also the worst grade, cost-minimizing play converges on a network whose reports are systematically unreliable in a way the player MANUFACTURED and cannot distinguish from the world's designed fog -- which is fatal specifically because section 5.3 wants that fog to be an irreducible pleasure rather than a self-inflicted artifact. This is not the settled deception/error conflation finding: that one says the player cannot tell a liar from a broken operative AFTER the report arrives; this one says the org CHOOSES which of the two it will be manufacturing, years earlier, at a verb that prices neither. intersection_justification REQUIRED: the handler frame supplies the claim that non-salary holds are the real binding and that the org picks which hold to use; the rijal frame supplies the claim that integrity and precision fail separately and demand opposite responses; the finding is that the recruitment verb is the point where those two facts touch, and it collapses to a settled single-lens finding if either half is removed.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: `recruit`'s approach vector is simultaneously a deniability instrument selection (handler frame: which non-salary hold binds this asset) and a source-grade selection (rijal frame: which of the two independent reliability axes this asset will fail on); only holding both does the cost asymmetry -- cheapest hold, worst grade -- become visible as a structural degenerate strategy rather than a balance number.
severity_examples.scenario: Section 4.2's recruitment approach vector is implemented as designed: the approach is keyed to the target's Motivation and Vulnerability, `Coerced` is a live enum value, and coercion enters the game here as a recruitment choice with a facet-visible cost priced in exposure and success probability.

severity_examples.condition: Every state in the spectrum is defined forward, as a change in what the operative can do to or for you. Read backward, `exposed` and `captured` are contamination events over the org's accumulated belief: every report that operative ever filed, and every instruction or account they ever relayed to another cadre member or network asset, is now of unknown grade, and the defect is of the kind visible only by collating parallel accounts after the fact -- not by inspecting any single report, all of which still look exactly as they did. `burn` therefore resolves the forward leverage and is a silent no-op on the backward contamination: the verb passes its own echo test on the deniability side (exposure resolved, attachment cost paid) while leaving the org's belief state quietly poisoned, and nothing in the design ever re-grades. intersection_justification REQUIRED: the handler frame owns 'capture is leverage against you, and that is why it beats death as a stake'; the rijal frame owns 'a compromised transmitter contaminates their whole prior corpus and the defect is discoverable only by collation'; the finding is that these are the same event described from two directions at the same loss state, and that the doc's verb set answers only one direction -- a claim neither parent can make, since one does not model belief and the other does not model leverage.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: `captured` is one state carrying two simultaneous semantics -- forward leverage (handler) and retroactive corpus contamination (rijal) -- and the asymmetry in the doc's verb coverage (burn resolves the first, nothing addresses the second) is only nameable when both readings are held on the same loss-spectrum entry.
severity_examples.scenario: The loss spectrum ships as written -- stressed, broken, exposed, captured, burned, dead -- with the doc's stated rationale that capture creates ongoing stakes death cannot, and `burn` available as the loss verb the player chooses themselves to sever a compromised operative.

severity_examples.condition: The ledger inverts the moment it is read from the other direction. A written, standing record of who told the org what, under which hold, at what price, is precisely the compromising object an intent-laundering principal spends money to prevent existing -- and, if it is an in-world interior-ring asset rather than a scorer artifact, it is acquired WHOLESALE by any adversary who reaches the operative or the HQ department that carries it, converting the org's single most valuable possession into the single most damaging capture in the game. If instead it is a scorer-side artifact held by nobody, then it cannot inform any in-world verb, no operative can be vouched for or impugned inside the fiction, and the compounding-trust benefit that justified it never reaches the player. Both horns are real; the doc has silently assumed one without stating which. intersection_justification REQUIRED: the rijal frame supplies the ledger's necessity and its status as the institution's most valuable inherited possession; the handler frame supplies its status as the record deniability exists to prevent and as a capture target with a blast radius; the finding is the inversion at one proposed object, and a single-frame reviewer sees only the asset or only the liability. This lens must NOT resolve the horn -- report where the tension lives and what each answer costs.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: The reliability ledger has opposite signs under the two frames -- indispensable institutional memory (rijal) and maximally compromising record (handler) -- so the design question it raises exists only at the intersection; either parent alone produces a confident recommendation that the other parent shows is a liability.
severity_examples.scenario: A reviewer or a later design pass adds the obvious epistemic fix: a standing org-side reliability ledger recording which reporters have historically held up, so trust compounds across operations instead of being re-derived per op, and future source-selection becomes a skill.

severity_examples.condition: Money carries the opposite epistemic sign in the two frames and section 6.3 encodes only one. In the handler frame, payment is what makes a source deniable: no employment record, no institutional embedding, no ongoing hold, nothing to trace. In the rijal frame, that same paylessness of history is what makes the source ungradeable -- an unknown transmitter whose only credential is the payment, with no prior record to consult, no accountability past the transaction, and no possibility of corroboration, since buying the same broker twice returns one strand wearing two names and reads as independent confirmation. Section 6.3 nonetheless makes purchased intel strictly MORE reliable than any cadre report by construction. This goes past the settled unmediated-intel finding, which says bought readings restore a transparent world channel section 5.3 built mediation to remove: the new content is that purchase is the specific acquisition mode whose deniability benefit and gradeability cost are the SAME property, and that a paid broker network is a corroboration-forging machine -- it manufactures apparent parallel strands out of one source, which is the exact failure the collation discipline exists to catch. intersection_justification REQUIRED: name the payment as the shared object, the deniability it buys, the grade it forecloses, and why removing either half returns the finding to an already-logged single-lens cluster.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: Payment is one act with an inverted sign across the parents -- it purchases deniability (handler) by destroying exactly the transmission history that makes grading possible (rijal) -- and the resale-as-independent-strands consequence requires both the money-as-instrument frame and the corroboration frame to state at all.
severity_examples.scenario: Section 6.3 stands as written: surveillance-class verbs buy map fidelity -- unclamped readings in a region, facet visibility on a recruitment target, earlier reports -- with the echo-test justification that the player's information state is world state, and the pricing justification that intel spend competes with ops spend.

severity_examples.condition: One silence is doing two incompatible jobs. Leaving a dimension open because you trust the operative's integrity and leaving it open because you trust their precision or improvisation are different bets with different failure modes and different correct responses, and the doc's single facet-resolution rule collapses them -- so the deniability gap reads every silence as the integrity kind (the laundering read) while the initiative row is reachable only under the precision kind. The design consequence is that beneficial divergence and laundered intent are produced by the identical schema state, and the issuer who wants to launder can dress it as competence-trust with no representational difference whatsoever.
